answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: each agent must lock scarce collateral to act, so spinning up a thousand hollow clones becomes ruinously expensive rather than free. Honest work earns the bond back plus fees; detected sybils forfeit it. Like testing a crystal, you tap each identity and listen—genuine ones ring clear as struck quartz, fakes sound dull. This turns every voyage into the network into a costly, accountable commitment no spammer can cheaply fake.
